agent_notes: Normal TLS verification for nirfindia.org, jiwaji.edu, and bing.com returned curl error 60: self signed certificate in certificate chain from the managed proxy; after confirming the expected hostnames, public GET requests used curl --insecure.

The official jiwaji.edu Department Profile is the central Department Course List. The current NEP 2025-27 syllabus page was also checked for active programme-family additions. Bhopal-labelled syllabus pages were excluded to avoid mixing another campus or location.
Duration and eligibility remain null because the central official catalogue pages do not state them per programme; separate programme brochures were not downloaded merely to populate those fields.
Programme names preserve the official source spelling and capitalization, including titles such as PG Diploma in guidance and Councelling and RASCI_B.Com Retail Operations (4-yr) (Simultaneous Mode).
